---
title: KU ADRC Custom Report
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    keep-tex: false
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
params:
  titles: NULL
  tables_path: NULL
---

## Here is Your Custom Report

```{r add-tables}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| ft.align: left

source("functions.R")

library(magrittr)

load(params$tables_path)

for (i in seq_along(tables)) {
  cat(paste0("", params$titles[[i]], ""), sep = "\n")
  tables[[i]] |>
    flextable::flextable() |>
    flextable::autofit() |>
    ft_add_theme() |>
    flextable::flextable_to_rmd()
}

```
